heroText: Örebro is a Sweden base best planned around named sights rather than a generic stopover. Start with Orebro Castle, add Wadkoping, and use Stadsparken to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Örebro International Airport handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.label: 13th century
history.text: The location became a natural seat of commerce in the Scandinavian Middle Ages and is mentioned in print in the 13th century.
The prefix Öre- is derived from ör 'gravel (bank)'. Örebro received its Royal Charter and city privileges not later than 1404.

history.label: 19th century
history.text: Although a trade town, Örebro remained small until the second half of the 19th century, when it grew rapidly as a center of the national shoe-manufacturing industry. 2025 Risbergska school shooting On 4 February.
Notable events in Örebro's history include the national diet meeting at Örebro in 1810, where Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte was elected crown prince of Sweden.
